invite.createLead: Choose a password to activate your account. No password was sent to you.

invite.joinLead: You keep access to your other organizations. You can switch between them from the header.
invite.invalidTitle: This invitation link is no longer valid.

invite.loadError: The invitation could not be loaded right now. Please try again.

forgot.title: Forgot your password
forgot.lead: Enter your email address: if an account exists, we will send you a link to choose a new password.
forgot.sent: If an account exists for this address, a link has been sent. It is valid for 2 hours.
forgot.sendError: Could not send the request right now. Please try again.

reset.title: Choose a new password
reset.done: Password changed. Sign in with the new one.
reset.expiredLead: The link is valid for 2 hours and works only once. Request a new one.

errors.forbiddenBody: You don't have permission to access this page.

onboarding.welcomeSubtitle: Create your first WhatsApp AI agent in minutes. You can change everything later.

onboarding.agentsCount: {count, plural, one {# AI agent} other {# AI agents}} in draft
onboarding.stepCreateDesc: Name, languages and personality of your assistant.
onboarding.stepPersonalizeDesc: Tune the tone, simulate a conversation for free.
onboarding.stepActivateDesc: Bring your AI agent online for your customers.

wizard.identityTitle: Bring your AI agent to life
wizard.identityLead: Let's start with the basics: its name and the languages it will speak to your customers.
wizard.identityLeadWithEntity: Let's start with the basics: its name, its entity and the languages it will speak to your customers.
wizard.entityHint: The AI agent will belong to this entity. You can move it later from Organization › Entities.
wizard.name: AI agent name
wizard.languagesHint: The AI agent replies in the customer's language. Personality is written per language.

wizard.advancedHint: editable · overrides guided mode for this language
wizard.leadHint: Fields the AI agent will try to collect (lead).
wizard.createError: Creation failed. Check the fields and try again.

simulate.title: Chat with your AI agent
simulate.lead: Test its behavior like a real customer. Edit the personality in the previous step if needed.
simulate.freeBadge: Free simulation: platform keys, Haiku model. No quota consumption.

success.title: Your AI agent is ready
success.subtitle: "{name}" is created as a draft. It does not receive customers yet. Connect it to WhatsApp then activate it.
success.connectDesc: Link your WhatsApp Business number to bring the AI agent online.

noOrganization.title: No organization
noOrganization.body: You don't have access to any organization at the moment. If you are waiting for an invitation, open the link you received by email; otherwise contact your organization's administrator.

organisations.title: Organizations
organisations.subtitle: The organizations you can access, and your role in each.

security.title: Security
security.emailHint: Used as your login, cannot be changed.

settings.title: Settings
settings.subtitle: Rules that apply to all members of {name}.
settings.panelLead: Who sees which contacts received by the organization's AI agents.
settings.footnote: Only mode available today: nothing to save. The choice will become editable with Conversations & Leads.

all.title: Everyone sees everything
all.description: Every member sees the conversations and leads of all entities.

entities.title: Everyone sees their entities
entities.description: Managers and advisors only see the entities they belong to.

own_and_pool.title: Everyone sees their contacts and the pool
own_and_pool.description: An advisor only sees the contacts they follow and those waiting to be picked up.

entities.title: Entities
entities.subtitle: Shops, teams or departments of the organization. Each AI agent belongs to one entity; managers and advisors are attached to one or more entities.

entities.inputHint: Enter to confirm, Esc to cancel

archive.title: Archive “{name}”?

archive.blockedAgents: Not possible yet: AI agents are still attached to it. Move them to another entity first.
archive.blockedMembers: Not possible yet: members are still attached to it. Move them to another entity first.
archive.membersLink: {count, plural, one {See the member →} other {See the # members →}}
archive.confirmText: The entity disappears from lists and selectors. You can reactivate it from “Show archived”.

move.title: Move an AI agent
move.text: From “{source}”. The WhatsApp number, connections and history do not change.
move.hint: Members of {target} will see it as soon as per-entity visibility exists; today everyone sees everything.

users.title: Users
users.subtitle: {members, plural, one {# member} other {# members}} · {invitations, plural, one {# pending invitation} other {# pending invitations}}

drawer.inviteSub: They will receive a link valid for 7 days to join {org}.
drawer.adminDescription: Everything, configuration included: AI agents, entities, users, settings. The only role that can invite.
drawer.superManagerDescription: All entities, present and future. No configuration.
drawer.readOnlyHint: : can look but not act, simulator included.
drawer.info: Today, managers and advisors have the same rights: see AI agents, leads and use the simulator. The difference (assigning contacts) arrives with Conversations & Leads.

suspend.title: Suspend {email}?
suspend.text: They lose access to {org} immediately. Their other organizations are not affected. You can reactivate them at any time, with the same access.
